name: Conditional Curse
body:
Your curse hinders you half as often as it otherwise might.

Prerequisites: Curse class feature.

Benefit: Choose one of the following pairs of conditions when you gain this feat: night/day, inside/outside. Choose one of the two conditions in the chosen pair. When that condition is true, you suffer from your curse; when the other is true, you do not suffer from the curse. You retain the benefits from your curse at all times however.
